verdict.rationale: Stripe documents the drop-in pattern directly: the server returns a client_secret and the client calls collectFinancialConnectionsAccounts to launch Stripe's authentication flow. In that flow users pick from frequently chosen institutions or search 12,000+ banks, so the developer builds no institution UI or custom bank form, and a beta integrator reports moving from Plaid Auth onto it. missing for 10: explicit evidence of the account object/ID returned to the client after linking (only the account-linked webhook is shown), and explicit documentation of the server-side session-creation call itself.
